name: documind-ai
description: DOCUMIND-AI - Intelligent Document Research & Knowledge Platform

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "backend,frontend,ai-service" -c "cyan,magenta,yellow" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend" ".\.venv\Scripts\python.exe -m uvicorn main:app --port 8000 --app-dir ai-service"
scripts.dev:web: concurrently -n "backend,frontend" -c "cyan,magenta" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix backend && npm install --prefix frontend
